title: Globalization and U.S. Corporate Tax Policies: Evidence From Import Competition
eligible_reason: Not eligible: continuous treatment intensity with a single adoption date. The main regressor is postntr = post x ntrgap, where ntrgap is the industry-level NTR tariff gap (continuous) and post = 1 for fiscal years >= 2001 (PNTR granted to China), with firm FE and year FE (xtreg ... i.fyear, fe cluster(ind)); most columns add time-varying firm controls. Table 10 uses binary high-import-penetration or targeted-industry indicators interacted with post-2018, again a single date. No staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: Main.do: workfile_1990_2007.dta, treatment postntr = (fyear>=2001)*ntrgap; outcomes cetr, ddbtd (Table 2), getr cfetr mpbtd btd etrdiff (Table 3); Table 4 ntrgap_seg; Table 5 p_ipr_usch1 (import penetration); Tables 6-7 subsample splits; Table 8 tax-haven outcomes; Table 9 offshore counts; Figure B1 ntrgap x year event study with industry trends and state-year FE; Table 10 2015-2019 panel with post-2018 x highImportPenetration / targetIndustry. Controls mb lev roa dfi fi ppe rd cap size. Data: Compustat-derived workfiles included.
